one_line: Open on the finished cover with the child's name, then show that name in the story text before the offer.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down: a hand holds a hardcover on a white blanket, a cartoon toddler in a cowboy hat on the cover. Text and voice (transcript): "זה אחד הדברים הכי מיוחדים שקיבלנו לאחרונה". Mirror-effect transition at 0:03.
q1_hook.why: The finished cover, with the child's name in its title, is handled from frame one, and text and voice open together (S1, H6, T3). The first-person superlative names no benefit, so the value lands only around 0:07 to 0:13 (H1, H2). The text clears the top 14% (T4).

beats.what: Top-down hand holds the cover on a white blanket; "זה אחד הדברים הכי מיוחדים שקיבלנו לאחרונה"
beats.why: Product and claim in the first frame

beats.what: Mirror transition; a toddler on a rug picks up the book; "סוף סוף הגיע לנו הספר בעיצוב אישי"
beats.why: The unboxing gives a human moment

beats.what: Close-up of the cover character; "האיורים כל כך מדויקים, שממש אפשר לזהות אותו"
beats.why: States the likeness claim at a large scale

beats.what: Dissolve, hand flips two spreads, then a text page; "השם שלו מופיע בכל הספר"
beats.why: The name in the story text is shown, not just said

beats.what: Toddler and adult point at the barn picture; a top-down spread; "וכל הסיפור נבנה סביבו"
beats.why: A child engaging, with a new angle each 2 to 4 s

beats.what: Top-down vegetable-garden spread; "זו מזכרת אישית שנשארת לשנים"
Toddler lifts and hugs the book, back cover seen; "מחכה לכן קופון בתיאור 🤍"
beats.why: The offer arrives right after the feeling

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption teases "והתגובה שלו? בכלל שברה אותי" and ends on a code; it asks for no comment, share or save.
q2_flow.why: A new image every 2 to 4 s, with a card per voice line, and a clear receive, open, surprise, keepsake line (R3, K2). The 3 s on a text page adds little (R1). The caption promises the child's reaction, but the video shows only handling the book, a small unpaid loop (H5).

q3_cta.what: Written at 0:26 to 0:29: "אם אתן מחפשות משהו באמת מיוחד לילדים שלכן מחכה לכן קופון בתיאור 🤍", and said (transcript). Caption, last line: a 10% discount with the code "Adib".
q3_cta.why: One ask, said and shown after the feeling and repeated in the caption (C1, C6), with a real 10% benefit (C2). But the video does not name the amount, the code is on the caption's last line, not its first, and the text drops into the bottom band (C6).

q4_shown.what: The finished cover with the child's name in the title, 0:00 and 0:08; a toddler unboxing, picking up and hugging the book, an adult beside her; barn and garden spreads; a text page with the name; the back cover. No price, no screen recording.
q4_shown.why: The name in the printed text is held for about 3 s, a checkable proof (S2), and the parent says she opened it herself (S6). The toddler's face appears with the name on the cover (S5). The real child is never shown beside the character (S2). The book is handled from 0:00 (S1).

q5_edit.what: 9 shots in 29.8 s, about 3.3 s each. Hard cuts, a mirror-effect transition at 0:03, a dissolve at 0:10. No speed changes seen. One text card per voice line, 3 to 4 lines, held 3 to 4 s. Ends on the toddler and book.
q5_edit.why: A change by 0:03 and a shot every few seconds keep a moderate pace (E1, E2). Voice and cards stay in step, though each card is a full sentence (E4). It ends on the offer with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother's first reaction to a personalised farm book for her toddler: accurate pictures, the name throughout, a keepsake, with a code. It serves gift buyers who want something meaningful.
q6_topic.why: "לא עוד מתנה, מזכרת אישית" is gift framing with no named occasion (K7), and a gift idea is easy to send on (R5). The feeling is tender, not a peak (K1). The claims are about feelings, not development, so they stay modest (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld top-down shots of the cover and pages on a blanket and a table; a static medium floor shot of a toddler on a rug with an adult kneeling; close-ups of the cover character and a text page. Warm lamp light; no adult face.
q7_filmed.why: Real clutter and lamp light read as a home video (H8, F7). Top-down hands put the viewer in the reader's seat (F5). The text page is shot close enough to read at phone size (F4). The toddler's face carries the feeling (K8).

q8_text.on_screen: Plain white text with a dark outline, 3 to 4 lines, centred, one card per voice line, mostly about 20 to 37% down: "זה אחד הדברים הכי מיוחדים שקיבלנו לאחרונה ..." (0:00), "סוף סוף הגיע לנו הספר בעיצוב אישי" (0:04), "השם שלו מופיע בכל הספר וזה מרגיש שהסיפור נכתב ממש עליו" (0:14), "זו מזכרת אישית שנשארת לשנים" (0:24), then the offer card (0:26, about 69 to 84% down).
q8_text.caption: "לא ציפיתי שזה ירגש אותי ככה…". Four short lines, about 40 words: the feeling, the child seen in a book, "והתגובה שלו? בכלל שברה אותי", then the gift line with the 10% code. No question, no hashtags, no disclosure word.
q8_text.why: Cards track every voice line, so it works muted (T1), but each is a full sentence of 3 to 4 lines (T2). Text starts clear of the top 14%, then drops into the bottom 35% for the offer, over the toddler (T4, F2). Caption: no product words or hashtags (T7); no disclosure word (T8).

weak_points: Generic praise lines; full-sentence cards of 3 to 4 lines; the offer text over the toddler in the bottom band; no real photo beside the cover; a promised reaction not shown; no disclosure word.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the cover top-down on a blanket, then a page-flip close-up where the name shows in the printed text; end with the offer said and written inside the safe zone.
not_verified: Whether the paid-partnership label was shown; whether music plays; who the woman beside the toddler is. The transcript has errors, so burned-in text is quoted. The child's name is on the cover, text page, cards and caption, not quoted. Correction to coded file: the cards sit about 20 to 37% down, but the offer card at 0:26 sits at 69 to 84%.
